messages: Noah Lee: Quick design review on the Compliance panel — a few small but important UX/a11y nits that could cause compliance mistakes. Main ones: region appears editable even when org policy locks it, retention field shows a number with no unit, and KMS toggle copy is inconsistent between UI and audit events. Priya Nair: Thanks Noah. For region: if org policy enforces a single allowed region, replace the dropdown with a read-only field + lock icon and an inline note: 'Region set by organization policy (policy-id: POL-2026)'. Make the lock keyboard-focusable and announce the policy ID with aria-describedby. Rina Patel: Retention should always include units. Change label from 'Retention' -> 'Data retention period (days)'. In the compact summary card show '90 days' not '90'. For presets, use segmented controls with radio semantics: 30 / 90 / 365 / Custom. When Custom is selected, reveal a number input. Noah Lee: KMS copy: current UI 'Enable KMS' vs audit 'Customer-managed keys enabled' is confusing. Standardize to UI copy: 'Use customer-managed encryption keys (KMS)'. Audit events should be past tense with actor: e.g. 'Noah Lee enabled customer-managed keys (key-id: fk-987)'. SupportBot: Automated check: tooltip roles missing on region lock, retention input missing aria-live for keyboard changes, and KMS toggle uses aria-role="checkbox" (should be role="switch"). See /internal/a11y/checklist#compliance. Priya Nair: Accessibility nit: when retention is changed via arrow keys, announce "Data retention: X days" via an aria-live polite region. Also ensure the numeric input has step=1 and pageStep=10 for PageUp/PageDown. Rina Patel: Visual contrast: the lock badge is using a low-contrast gray on the white panel; propose brand-blue #0a4bd6 for badge foreground and white badge bg to meet 4.5:1. I'll add token --badge-enforced-foreground in the design tokens PR. Noah Lee: Also for CSV exports and audit screenshots, include units and policy ids. CSV column header should be 'data_retention_days' and not just 'retention'. Priya Nair: Example audit lines we should standardize in schema: "Priya Nair set data retention to 90 days (previous: 30 days)" and "Rina Patel enabled customer-managed keys (key-id: fk-987)". Add previous_state where applicable. Rina Patel: Small interaction note: when region is org-enforced, pressing Enter on the lock badge should open a small read-only modal with the policy text and a link to the org policy in the admin console. Modal must trap focus and have descriptive heading. SupportBot: Suggested HTML snippet for the toggle and badge: ```html Audit logs will include key-id when enabled. Enforced by organization policy POL-2026. Press Enter for details. ``` Make sure the button uses accessible name and the modal is reachable via keyboard. Noah Lee: OK plan: Rina will PR the visual tokens + modal, Priya will update labels and audit examples, and I will coordinate with infra to add policy-id and previous_state to audit schema. Targeting next sprint; please paste Figma link and screenshots in the PR. Priya Nair: Will do. Adding checklist to the PR description: update UI copy, add aria-live for retention, change role to switch, make lock focusable, update CSV headers, and include audit sample lines. Rina Patel: I'll include high-contrast screenshots and token changes. Tagging @Noah for policy schema fields. Noah Lee: Thanks team — these are small but reduce a lot of compliance risk. :lock:
